about: Vetting back-test from real job postings (Nov 8-9 2026) against evals/fixture_profile.json, a Java full-stack developer on an H-1B transfer in Illinois. Descriptions are excerpted or condensed. Cases marked synthetic test a rule no real posting exercised. Once you have run the skill a few times, add cases from your own postings with your own profile's expected outcomes.
